origin: Hornady Handbook 10th ed., Lyman 50th ed., Speer, Barnes, Federal, Winchester, Western and other published load data (scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 82 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (8 cartridges), velocity error 3.5 % rms, pressure error 0 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, single-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
